system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: epashu_verify_otp and epashu_raise_grievance. For your information, my description is dummy_description_6336, my grievance_category is dummy_grievance_category_8337, my aadhaar_number is 100020009914, my otp is dummy_otp_4861.

function.name: epashu_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT create listings. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

function.name: epashu_raise_grievance
function.description: Raises a grievance. Categories: 'fraudulent_listing', 'payment_issue', 'delivery_issue', 'incorrect_details', 'ownership_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.
